summary: Fixed a lost-invalidation race in authenticated voice-roster SSE: the handler now subscribes before loading its initial ACL-checked snapshot. Changes arriving during the query remain queued and trigger a fresh snapshot. The live two-account/server roster acceptance remains open.

checks.name: Regression test before fix
checks.observation: Reproduced the bug: the first snapshot arrived, the notification emitted during List was lost, and the stream timed out with one List call.

checks.name: Roster SSE package tests after fix
checks.observation: Initial snapshot, notification refresh and notification-during-initial-snapshot tests pass.

checks.name: Roster SSE race detector
checks.observation: The changed package passes under Go's race detector.

checks.name: Complete backend suite
checks.observation: All backend packages pass after the fix. Local httptest requires permission to bind loopback ports.

checks.name: Live two-account and deployed webhook verification
checks.observation: No deployed LiveKit webhook/SSE stream or cross-account privacy session was exercised.

remaining: Verify room join/leave and screen-share invalidation against the deployed webhook with two separate accounts, including disconnect/reconnect, ACL isolation and visible refresh latency.
